provenance.license: No CAD license declaration found in inspected repository; manufacturer copyright retained, no MIT label asserted.
provenance.sourcePolicy: Official CAD candidates are recorded independently in the model source audit; an uncalibrated model is not silently substituted for another SKU.
provenance.tessellation: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; 0.05 mm absolute deflection and 0.2 rad; native mm with rigid source transform.

limitations: The manufacturer STEP contains the case structure and side inserts. The screen and keyboard front are constrained by a straight official photo. The fascia and keycap depth are viewing estimates.
The matched original T-Deck trackball STEP is rigidly placed at the photographed Plus trackball center.
The visible enclosure preview covers a configuration with the external antenna removed. Exact keypad height, internal PCB layout, battery fit and antenna variants are unspecified.

debugPreview.reason: The native Plus shell defines the body. An orthographic official photo locates the screen and controls.

representationScope: Official Plus shell and inserts, photo-aligned external fascia, display and keys, and a matched original T-Deck trackball. The front and rear enclosure layers separate for viewing.

manualPhotoCalibration.sourceImageMask: The active source display, ball and raised key footprint are covered with neutral colours on the fascia. Separate keycap textures exclude source display content.

sourceTransform.note: Rigid transform only; supplied assembly placements and native millimetres retained.
